notes: Founding finding (Tim White, 2026-11-19, 'reviews raise the baseline'): design/code review findings die as one-off PR comments, so the system baseline never rises. Encoding: this ledger, docs/design-system/REVIEW_FINDINGS_ENCODING.md, and apps/web/scripts/lint-review-findings.mjs. Bootstrap/process entry; the PR that carries this encoding is referenced in its PR body.

ASR-022 (No all-caps eyebrow by default, status planned) had no static check; encoded here as the shadow rule above. The pattern matches ONLY uppercase + extreme-wide tracking (tracking-widest or arbitrary >= 0.2em). False-positive analysis: the established micro-label idiom (uppercase + tracking-wide / [0.08em] / [0.12em] on small meta labels, 86 occurrences on main) is sanctioned structure; the pattern deliberately excludes it, and wide tracking without uppercase (OTP digit inputs, apps/web/components/atoms/auth-text-input-styles.ts:19) is legitimate typography. Findings: (a) apps/web/app/sentry-example-page/page.tsx:7 uppercase tracking-[0.2em] eyebrow — FIXED in the encoding PR; SCREEN_REGISTRY row web.sentry-example added. (b) OPEN debt, 2 occurrences not fixed here (visible-UI copy surfaces — needs the normal design pass, not a drive-by): apps/web/components/features/landing/VoiceDemoVisual.tsx:35 and apps/web/app/investor-portal/_components/MemoContent.tsx:83 (both uppercase tracking-widest eyebrows).

Evidence: production tip 82b7ce56 / apps/web/lib/chat/run.ts uses smoothStream({ delayInMs: 15, chunking: 'word' }) with experimental_throttle: 50 (JOV-3525). Claimed delayInMs:5 not present at tip (ai package default delayInMs=10) — unverifiable under ASR-046. Encoding: ASR-042 shadow + scripts/anti-slop/rsi-prevention fixtures. Known production hit stays with pacing owners; this lane does not change delayInMs. Legitimate control: documented retry/backoff/debounce off success path.

ASR-043: Audience nav warm used bare queryKeys.audience.members(profileId) while DashboardAudienceClient reads useAudienceInfiniteQuery with sort/direction/segments/view. Identity (/app/presence) warmed dspEnrichment.presence while the route mounts ProfilesWorkspace. Fix in same lane: audience prefetchInfiniteQuery + shared audience-members-params defaults; presence warm removed (SSR-first). Executable guard: apps/web/tests/unit/queries/prefetch-dashboard.test.ts + scripts/anti-slop/rsi-prevention fixtures. No lint rule_pattern here — scanning apps/web/{components,app} would false-positive legitimate dspEnrichment.presence consumers (e.g. DspPresenceView). False-positive evidence: RF pattern draft hit components/features/dashboard/organisms/dsp-presence/DspPresenceView.tsx:55.

ASR-044: optional/stale loads must keep prior valid values, leave skipped counts null (JOV-1262), and never present lifetime totals as period spikes. Fixture pair under scripts/anti-slop/rsi-prevention/fixtures/ASR-044.*. Audience already uses keepPreviousData + null totals — preserve that contract; do not drive-by rewrite analytics owners.

ASR-045 review-only: popover detach, keyboard-only focus rings (not hover), nested radius=outer-padding without clip, drawer resize must not fire column-reorder animation, composer focus must not activate Attach. Encode on shared primitives + browser fixtures; no per-screen patches in this lane. Existing ComposerAttachButton tests cover click open; focus≠Attach and drawer/popover remain review signals until browser fixtures land with their owners.

ASR-046: skipped/unverifiable evidence cannot count as PASS or support a shipped claim. Executable hold semantics already live in scripts/lib/outcome-residual-policy.mjs (INV-TERMINAL-RECEIPT-1). RSI contract fixtures ASR-046.bad/good prove decideOutcomeResidual holds on mandatory unverifiable and passes only when verified. Example: delayInMs:5 claim is unverifiable at tip — recorded as such, not as a PASS finding.
